items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wanted to play like Lester Young... He’s working at the Pershing with Pres [Lester Young] and everybody... Everybody knew them. Because if they came to town without – like if Count Basie come here without Pres, he might as well not come. Everybody’s waiting for Pres.

ctx.x: He was about the only – well, he and Rudy Vallee. But, you know, I wanted to play like Lester Young, Coleman Hawkins.
So you needed a real tenor.
